key.name: application-list
key.description: List of application desktop file IDs or WM_CLASS rules.

key.name: focus-new-workspace
key.description: If true, switch focus to the new workspace when moving a window. If false, keep focus on the current workspace.

key.name: ignore-empty-workspace
key.summary: Ignore if current workspace is empty
key.description: If true, keeps the application on the current workspace if it contains no other windows.
